name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Account Manager — SaaS Expansion & Consultative Sales
summary: B2B SaaS Account Manager with 15+ years expanding relationships within established accounts across agencies, professional-services firms, and service-based businesses. At Accelo, sold and scoped a work-management and CRM/PSA platform directly comparable to Wrike, ranking top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps. Consistently identifies expansion opportunities within existing accounts, retainer growth, cross-sell, and upsell, rather than cold outbound, and has personally closed six-figure annual contracts through consultative, solution-based selling.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand retainer scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with client objectives.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Personally sold and closed 2 client accounts using programmatic advertising, each at ~$30K MRR (~$360K annualized contract value), owning the client relationship and strategy while a specialist team executed the buys.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15–20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K–$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K) — roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped a complex work-management, CRM, and project-management (PSA) platform to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.
Ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps, holding that rank across all but the final few months of a 27-month tenure, while quota roughly doubled over the period.
Consistently performed above commission floor into accelerator ("doubling") tiers, averaging ~$17,750/month in implementation/services bookings (~$213K annualized).
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Advised clients on CRM adoption, building scalable operational systems aligned to their growth stage and team structure.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
